lines.text: Many learners say: I pretend to travel next year.
Better: I plan to travel next year.
Pretend means to act like something is true.
Plan! I plan to study more.

data.wrong: I pretend to travel next year.
data.right: I plan to travel next year.
data.why: Pretend means to act like something is true.

native.tip: “Pretend” em inglês significa fingir. Para dizer que você pretende fazer algo, use “plan”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este falso cognato! 😬 “I pretend to travel” quer dizer que você finge viajar. Para dizer que pretende viajar, diga “I plan to travel”. Ouça o Carlos e repita!
native.comment: Resposta: “plan”. Anote esta frase e treine outros falsos cognatos com um quiz grátis: {link}

en.tip: “Pretend” in English means to fake. To say you intend to do something, use “plan”.
en.caption: Watch out for this false friend! “I pretend to travel” means you are faking a trip. To say you intend to travel, say “I plan to travel”. Listen to Carlos and repeat!
